about: The AT-ST Cockpit Test study (claude.ai artifact, Nov 2026): an original walker cockpit - simple shapes made by a script, nothing from the films or other games and none of the game's files - fitted inside the game's AT-ST head, measured from its model. Three.js axes (x across - left negative, y up, z back - forward negative), game units; the floor at y 0. groups: triangles by material (pos float32 x3, nrm int8 x3, uv float32 x2 per corner; part uint16 per triangle, into parts), base64; mover: the group turns with that mover (movers: its pivot and axis). facts: game axes (x forward, y left, z up).

parts.name: Cabin walls
parts.desc: Fitted inside the game's AT-ST head, measured from its model: narrower at the face than at the back, the roof sloping down toward the front, the face leaning out over the chin guns.

parts.name: Roof
parts.desc: Sloping down toward the front as the head's does, with the hatch over the seats and a light each end.

parts.name: Floor
parts.desc: Tread plate. Under the front of it sit the chin guns.

parts.name: Outer plating
parts.desc: A plain skin round the cabin, for this look only: in the game the AT-ST head's own plating is round it, and its details are the game's, so they aren't drawn here.

parts.name: Visors
parts.desc: Plates over the viewports outside, as on the game's head: they shade the slits, and cut off your view upward.

parts.name: Left viewport
parts.desc: Yours: one of the head's two slits, as narrow as the model's, the visor over it. Lean in toward it to see more, and further down; the gun sight is on its glass.

parts.name: Right viewport
parts.desc: The second seat's. From yours it's a look out to the right.

parts.name: Gun sight
parts.desc: Where the guns point, on your viewport's glass. In the game the guns follow your head.

parts.name: Brow pads
parts.desc: Padded, under the roof edge over each viewport: rest your forehead on it and lean in to see more.

parts.name: Frames
parts.desc: The ribs the cabin is built on.

parts.name: Pilot's seat
parts.desc: Yours, behind the left viewport: low, with your legs out in front, as the head's height allows. With Play Seated on, your real chair is where this one is.

parts.name: Second seat
parts.desc: Behind the right viewport. The game's AT-ST takes one rider, so in the game this one stays empty - unless passengers come later.

parts.name: Gun bay
parts.desc: The chin guns' housing, up through the front of the floor where the head's chin is: your feet rest on it.

parts.name: Pilot's yoke
parts.desc: Both hands. Push it forward to walk, pull it back to back up, twist it to turn. The right grip's trigger fires the main guns, its thumb button the second weapon.

parts.name: Gun yoke
parts.desc: The second seat's grips for the side guns, should anyone sit there. You fire everything from your yoke.

parts.name: Instrument panel
parts.desc: Under the viewports, sloped toward you: a screen in front of each seat, the hull screen between them, and buttons.

parts.name: Buttons
parts.desc: Lights, the comms, the hatch lock - things you reach for with a finger.

parts.name: Ground camera
parts.desc: Under the walker's feet and just ahead: the ground the viewports can't show you.

parts.name: Hull screen
parts.desc: Armour and each leg: what the hits have done.

parts.name: Weapons screen
parts.desc: The main guns and the second weapon: ready, heat and ammo.

parts.name: Target screen
parts.desc: Between the viewports, fed by the camera in the block between the head's slits: what's ahead, and what the guns are on.

parts.name: Left side panel
parts.desc: Switches and lights on the wall beside your head, and the heading screen.

parts.name: Right side panel
parts.desc: The second seat's switches and lights, and the comms screen.

parts.name: Side gun mounts
parts.desc: Where the side guns turn, through the walls beside the seats, as on the head's outside.

parts.name: Hatch
parts.desc: Overhead, where the head's own hatch is: stand up from your seat and your head comes out through it. Turn the wheel and push to open.

parts.name: Grab handles
parts.desc: Either side of the hatch, to pull yourself up and out.

parts.name: Dome lights
parts.desc: One between your heads, one over the back of the cabin.

parts.name: Air fans
parts.desc: Cooling air for the cabin and the drive, on the back wall.

parts.name: Power cells
parts.desc: Between the fans: power for the lights and the screens with the drive off.

parts.name: Rear light
parts.desc: Over the power cells, lighting the back wall.

parts.name: Lockers
parts.desc: Stowage either side at the back.

parts.name: Extinguisher
parts.desc: In its bracket on the right wall, behind the second seat.

parts.name: Pipes
parts.desc: Power and coolant runs, from the back wall along the walls to the side panels.

parts.name: Floor lights
parts.desc: Dim red along the foot of each wall, so you can find your way in the dark.
